voiceOver.attempt: Enabled the VoiceOver switch in Accessibility settings, observed on, then attempted native Safari Control-Option-Shift-Down and Control-Option-Right interaction.
voiceOver.observed: No independent screen-reader cursor or spoken-output evidence. Acquiring VoiceOver app timed out. On subsequent settings inspection the switch was off; user subsequently confirmed they had turned it off because speech was bothering them.

authorizedRetry.method: User requested VoiceOver now. Enabled switch and observed on. Clicked native Safari editor, attempted Control-Option-Shift-Down and Control-Option-A.
authorizedRetry.observed: Shortcut input mutated editor content: Second plus nested Deep became one ordered item containing U+0001 followed by Deep emoji. One Control-Z restored Second and nested Deep. No spoken-output evidence captured; routing cause not established.
authorizedRetry.cleanup: Explicitly turned VoiceOver off; settings switch observed off. Editor content restored.

keyRoutingRegression.scope: Synthetic browser unit regressions only, not native VoiceOver qualification.
keyRoutingRegression.translationMatrix: Base and nested translators; both editing policies, both primary modifiers, shortcuts enabled and disabled. No command or text derived from any chord.
keyRoutingRegression.eventController: Each chord is ignored without preventDefault, queue submission or DOM mutation in the base controller fixture.
keyRoutingRegression.conclusion: Existing library keydown classification does not claim these chords. The previous native mutation's originating events and OS/automation routing are still unknown; no production fix justified.
keyRoutingRegression.nativeComparison: Not run: native-computer tools unavailable in this turn.

diagnosticMetadataFollowup.scope: Private flat-list IME diagnostic fixture only; not the qualified nested archive, not native certification, and not a production fix.
diagnosticMetadataFollowup.captures: Control/Option/Command/Shift flags and a fixed allowlist of shortcut key identities; data length and unique control-code units from the first at most 256 UTF-16 units. Ordinary text is never recorded by these new fields.
diagnosticMetadataFollowup.failureContainment: Metadata or DOM observation failure is contained without canceling event delivery.

plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.scope: Independent loopback HTML contenteditable control; no Breditor, Rust or Wasm. Logger records only event metadata, bounded control units and fixed key identities.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.voiceOver: User confirmed helping enable VoiceOver; System Settings observed on. VoiceOver Utility caption panel and cursor preferences already enabled and unchanged. Direct VoiceOver app-window read timed out.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.automation: Native tool sent Control-Option-A at the end of the plain nested Deep emoji item.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.result: Plain Safari inserted U+0001, reproducing the control-character symptom without Breditor. Command-Z restored the plain control; event log then cleared for a physical-key comparison.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.conclusion: The symptom is not specific to Breditor/Rust/Wasm. OS versus native-tool routing cause still unestablished; trusted automated events are not proof of physical screen-reader input.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.physicalComparison: User asked the agent to check independently instead. No physical-key result obtained; do not infer one from automated trusted events.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.configurationCheck: VoiceOver Utility Commands visibly configured the modifier as Control-Option or Caps Lock. Arrow-key and single-key Quick Nav were off; Always allow typing in text fields was on. These preferences were inspected, not changed.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.independentHelpAttempt: Automated Control-Option-H in VoiceOver Utility produced no visible Help menu or AX-tree change. This does not establish whether global screen-reader commands were delivered or consumed.
plainBrowserIsolationAfterReopen.cleanupAfterIndependentCheck: Explicitly switched VoiceOver off and observed off. Keyboard settings showed Canadian input, Globe key Show Emoji & Symbols and Dictation off. Dictation Languages remained English (Canada) and Japanese (Japan); clicking its Edit control returned AXError.failure. Dictation was not enabled for cleanup.

limitations: Native key automation is not physical operator IME evidence.
Accessibility tree inspection does not qualify a screen reader.
Do not infer editor defects from these inconclusive OS/control attempts.
